capture.method: Chrome DevTools Protocol Page.captureScreenshot against a live app instance (no desktop screen capture)
capture.postProcessing: macOS window controls redrawn at trafficLightPosition (14, 15) — the only chrome CDP cannot capture; nothing else edited or cropped

shots.feature: Takeoff — measurements, auto-counts and the takeoff worksheet
shots.caption-suggestion: Calibrate the sheet once, then measure in real units: 5,485 sq ft of gross floor area, two wall dimensions and a 17-piece diffuser count, all totalled in the Takeoff Worksheet.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101 (bundled sample, 24 x 18 in, 1" = 6')

shots.feature: Symbol Search — find and count every matching symbol
shots.caption-suggestion: Box one symbol and PolyPDF finds the rest: 17 matches on the sheet, each one reviewable before it becomes a count.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101

shots.feature: Markup and review — clouds, callouts, notes and the Markup Table
shots.caption-suggestion: Cloud the change, attach the RFI, and every markup lands in the Markup Table with status, author and date — ready to export.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101

shots.feature: Page scale — measurements in real-world units
shots.caption-suggestion: Set the page scale from the title block or calibrate off a known line; every measurement then reads in feet and inches, with the scale pinned in the status bar.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101

shots.feature: Built-in toolsets — MUTCD Regulatory signs (new in 1.3.1)
shots.caption-suggestion: Four MUTCD sign series ship in the box alongside the architectural, plumbing, electrical, HVAC and welding toolsets — drop an R1-1 straight onto the sheet.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101

shots.feature: PDF Maps plugin, CAD Linework style + live editor (new in 1.3.1)
shots.caption-suggestion: Type a location, pick CAD Linework, and the map arrives drawn like part of the set - shown here mid-edit with live zoom and style controls.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101; map of State Street, Madison, Wisconsin

shots.feature: Form builder — field palette and field properties
shots.caption-suggestion: Open any AcroForm and every field is listed with its type, flags and appearance; drag a new field from the palette to add one.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF sample form — invoice.pdf (42 form fields)

shots.feature: Search — full-text search across the drawing
shots.caption-suggestion: Search the sheet's text layer and every hit is highlighted in place, with page context in the results list.
shots.sheet: PolyPDF Quick Start — Office Fit-Out Plan, sheet Q-101
